title: Weekly sync agenda — serving runtime / infra / console
content:
Weekly cross-team sync — Serving Runtime / Infra / Console
Date: Tue 2026-03-03
Time: 10:00 - 10:45 PT
Location: Zoom (internal) / #eng-serving-runtime
Owner / note-taker: Aisha Patel
Attendees (planned): Aisha, Rohit, Liam, Sofia, Ethan, Priya (+ optional: Miko, Carlos)
Goal: unblock v1.12 rollout, surface infra capacity concerns, align console telemetry tasks and feature flags for rollout

AGENDA:
1) Quick metrics (5m)
   - P50 gen latency: 72ms (small prompts), P95: 240ms
   - Avg QPS last 24h: 1.7k sustained (peak 2.9k during Canary)
   - Error rate (4xx/5xx): 0.8% overall, 5xx spike on 2026-03-01 incident
   - GPU utilization (dedicated pools): 66% avg, 92% peak for pool-east-1
   - Note: bring recent traces for the 03/01 spike (Rohit)

2) Incidents & postmortems (8m)
   - 2026-03-01 spike: SR-incident-003 (kernel OOM under long-seq workload). Current status: rollback to kernel v7.3 on canary; mitigation merged to hotfix branch. Postmortem draft in Confluence (linked).
   - Action: confirm canary stability for 48h before rolling to prod (owner: Rohit).

3) v1.12 runtime rollout (10m)
   - Target prod rollout: 2026-03-05 EOD if canary stable.
   - Blocker: perf regression for sequences > 8k tokens (observed in canary). Preliminary bisect points to attention-kernel change (Liam investigating).
   - Tests: regression suite failing on long-seq — need a synthetic test harness run across GPU types (Ethan to schedule on infra testbed).

4) Dedicated autoscaling test / capacity planning (6m)
   - Infra ran autoscale experiment last week; observed slower scale-up time for pool-west-2 (6m cold start).
   - Proposed: pre-warm strategy + reserve burst nodes for identified customers. Cost modeling in sheet INF-capacity-2026-Q1 (linked).
   - Action: infra to propose pre-warm config and expected monthly cost delta (owner: Sofia, due 2026-03-09).

5) Console / observability items (6m)
   - Token-level cost breakdown: shipping minor UX change to route-level view (PR open). Need tracing hooks for model fallbacks to show in timeline (Priya to scope).
   - Alerting: add 95th/99th latency alert for canary route to avoid bad rollouts. (Aisha to create alert rule).

6) Open action items from last week (5m)
   - AI-previous-1: Add more telemetry for KV cache hit rate — DONE (merged, PR #835).
   - AI-previous-2: Improve canary traffic split policy to route by seq-length — IN PROGRESS (Liam, needs config change).
   - AI-previous-3: Docs update for dedicated pool autoscaling knobs — PENDING (Sofia).

7) New action items (5m)
   - AI-2026-03-01: Investigate perf regression on long sequences; produce hypothesis + plan (owner: Liam Zhang; due: 2026-03-04).
   - AI-2026-03-02: Run full regression harness across GPU variants for v1.12 canary (owner: Ethan Kim; due: 2026-03-04).
   - AI-2026-03-03: Draft pre-warm/reserve proposal with cost delta and runbook (owner: Sofia Martinez; due: 2026-03-09).
   - AI-2026-03-04: Add 95/99 latency alert to canary route and test noise immunity (owner: Aisha Patel; due: 2026-03-04).
   - AI-2026-03-05: Scope console tracing for model fallback timeline and create product ticket (owner: Priya Kapoor; due: 2026-03-06).

8) Blockers / Requests for help (3m)
   - Need access to private test tenant for running long-seq regression — Ethan (infra) to confirm by EOD.
   - Customer impact: one enterprise customer reported increased latencies during spike on 03/01; customer success looped in (CS owner: Maya). Need comms draft if rollback delayed beyond 03/05 (Aisha / Rohit).

9) AOB (1m)
   - Reminder: on-call rotation change next week (Rohit -> Liam). Update calendar and runbook.

NOTES TO SELF (informal):
- Keep meeting tight; push deep-dive on long-seq perf to follow-up deep dive with kernel folks.
- Bring perf flame graphs and allocator stats for the canary nodes (Liam).
- Ensure linked confluence PM is aware of slip risk on 03/05 rollout.

NEXT SYNC: Tue 2026-03-10 10:00 PT

ACTION-ITEM TRACKER (copy this into backlog after meeting):
- AI-2026-03-01 | Fix perf regression on long sequences | Liam Zhang | 2026-03-04 | status: in_progress | notes: bisect pointing at attention-kernel change; try revert patch or micro-optimizations
- AI-2026-03-02 | Run regression harness across GPUs | Ethan Kim | 2026-03-04 | status: todo | notes: needs infra testbed access + dataset (long-seq synthetic)
- AI-2026-03-03 | Pre-warm/reserve proposal for dedicated pools | Sofia Martinez | 2026-03-09 | status: todo | notes: include cost delta and rollback plan
- AI-2026-03-04 | Add canary latency alerts (95/99) | Aisha Patel | 2026-03-04 | status: todo | notes: ensure alert has noise suppression (5m window)
- AI-2026-03-05 | Console tracing for model fallback timeline | Priya Kapoor | 2026-03-06 | status: todo | notes: prototype using trace-id correlation from runtime

LINKS / REFERENCES:
- Runtime roadmap: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/Serving+Runtime+Roadmap
- Postmortem draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/SR-incident-003
- Regression PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/842
- Capacity sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/INF-capacity-2026-Q1

END OF AGENDA (draft)

Follow-ups: will tidy and circulate after meeting (owner: Aisha).
